changelog: Fixed the app freezing on launch when the Riot Client connection was slow. Banned accounts are now kept in their own Banned Accounts panel instead of being deleted, with a Recheck button that moves them back if they're playable again. Accounts are auto-tagged Ranked (level 20+) or Unrated (below 20), the Smurf tag and Delete Banned button are gone, regions are a dropdown, and the settings icon is now a cog.
